messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] pager-gateway-uk: outbound pages to PagerDuty are failing with HTTP 502 from gateway, started 03:22 UTC. affected services: auth, payments (uk region). automatic suppressor not tripped yet.
aj: seeing the same in logs, gateway -> pd-proxy returns 502. spike around 03:22-03:24.
michelle: can someone confirm if pages are reaching PagerDuty at all? customers reporting missed pages.
samir: quick check: PD events API is healthy from PD side. looks like our gateway is returning 502 for v1/events.
ops-shiftlead: oncall alerted? @oncall-sre are you on this?
oncall-sre: I'm on, joining. taking ownership of on-call coordination.
aj: workaround attempt: switching route to pd-fallback (different proxy) might push through. running curl test now:
```bash
curl -v -X POST 'https://our-gateway/api/pd/events' -d '{"test":"payload"}'
```
michelle: result?
aj: response: 502 up front, stacktrace points to upstream timeout + chunked-encoding handling.
oncall-sre: immediate mitigation: please enable manual SMS fallback for pager rules for auth/payments UK, and DM oncall rotation to confirm receipt. I'll coord with support.
michelle: enabling manual SMS fallback for those escalation policies now. posting CID list for affected customers in #support. :warning:
support-bot: Notifying support on-call and sending customer-facing incident stub.
samir: digging into gateway logs: saw an internal rate limiter kick in on the UK egress pool when parallel connections hit ~220, it started rejecting connections rather than queueing. suspect config regression from yesterday deploy.
aj: rollback of yesterday's gateway change? which diff touched the rate limiter?
oncall-sre: @samir can you confirm commit hash and if config was rolled out to the uk pool only?
samir: yes, config 6a1b2ef was deployed and set the egress throttle to 200 (from 400) for uk. it looks like an aggressive safety limit.
ops-shiftlead: who rolled that out?
michelle: that was part of the traffic-shaping PR to limit cross-region blast, merged by infra-team during a staged deploy.
oncall-sre: plan: revert 6a1b2ef on uk pool to restore previous throttle, enable gradual ramp, then monitor PD success rate. preparing rollback now.
aj: pre-rollout step: disable automatic suppressor to avoid silent suppression re-triggers while we fix. where is the suppressor config?
samir: suppressor lives in notify-proxy. disabling for uk temporarily: `notify-proxy --config /etc/notify/uk.yaml --suppressor off`
michelle: do it and post the command / output.
samir: ran it, output: "suppressor: disabled for region uk".
oncall-sre: initiating rollback of config 6a1b2ef to 4f9d3c0 on uk gateway now. will watch for burst and PD responses.
aj: POST tests now returning 202 via pd-fallback for test payload. running higher QPS smoke test.
michelle: customer impact: initial window (~03:22-03:32) possibly missed pages for high-priority incidents in UK. support already sent notices to impacted contacts.
oncall-sre: rollback confirmed applied at 03:28 UTC. PD event success rate improved to 99% by 03:30. continuing monitoring for 30m.
samir: creating follow-up ticket to audit deploy gating around rate-limit changes and add automated canary threshold for egress throttle on each region.
ops-shiftlead: action items: 1) postmortem created (assign to infra + notify-proxy owners), 2) add canary & automatic rollback on throttle metrics, 3) update runbook for manual SMS fallback steps.
oncall-sre: will stay on watch for next 60 minutes. thanks for quick responses. :thumbsup:
michelle: thanks team — please add timeline and list of affected escalation policies in the postmortem.
support-bot: Incident stub updated: INC-2026-1137, severity: P2, customer notifications sent.
aj: logging note: saved full gateway traces to s3://infra-logs/incident-7112233445 for later analysis.
michelle: closing the live coordination channel; keep updates on the postmortem doc.
oncall-sre: last check at 03:40 UTC shows stable PD deliveries. marking incident as mitigated.
